verdict.rationale: Fly.io supports deploying existing frameworks via tech-specific docs (fly-io-docs-2) and standard Dockerfile-based builds implied by 'fly launch', suggesting some compatibility with existing workflows, but it requires installing and learning a proprietary CLI (flyctl) and platform-specific deploy model (fly-io-docs-1), and there's no evidence in the pack of native CI, editor, or Git-workflow integration.
